entries.li: Fixed errors after uninstalling a cosmic printer.
Improved how the transport supplier interacts with shuttles and transport pods.
The author has moved to a new feedback website. This update changes the destination URL for in-game feedback. Feedback submitted after November 6 may be lost.
Errors thrown by other mods are now less likely to prevent a UI page from being built.
Improved the notice for special recipes from other mods that define no output.
The Cosmic Mech Gestator now inherits the components of the vanilla Mech Gestator to improve compatibility with more mods. This adds an extra power toggle button, which has no actual function.
Improved shelf rendering. Items that are difficult to render now appear as icons instead of being rendered in real time.
The production output port can now supply materials for surgery and mech gestation! For other jobs, use the auto-restocking shelf. We don't currently plan to add support for those jobs individually.
Production output ports and storage receivers now show a beam when transferring items.
Fixed incorrect rendering introduced in version 1.2.7 and improved rendering logic.

The production output port previously supplied automated production facilities from The Dead Man's Switch 2, but failed to consume ingredients, allowing production to start without using materials. This has now been fixed.
Improved shelf rendering rules: objects prone to rendering errors now use a placeholder texture directly.
Added a deconstruct storage conduit button.
Improved fuel supplier refueling rules.
Improved building descriptions.
Improved tip text.
You can now search for recipes and workbenches directly on the Production orders page.

Improved detection of items in storage when Nivarian buildings maintain production targets. (Note: Compatibility with this mod has already been improved several times; no further improvements will be made.)
Improved shelf selection compatibility with dd.logicalfloors.
Added defensive handling for errors when checking whether items can be grouped together.
Production orders can now be restricted to a specific workbench. Workbenches can be renamed to make selection easier.
Enable the option in settings to automatically assign orders added from a workbench to that workbench only. This option is disabled by default.
The filter above the production order list can hide orders that cannot be processed at the current workbench, including printer-only orders.
Printers can now be set to process only orders whose worker setting is "Printers only".
Added the performance-melting restocking shelf.
Cosmic printers can now be bound to colonists, using their skill levels and work speed to calculate production.
Cosmic printer parameters can now be copied to other printers, making it easier to configure multiple printers.
You can now increase the silver stack limit in the Accessibility settings to support payments made by other trading mods.
Hold Ctrl when clicking a recipe to keep the recipe picker open and add more recipes.
Storage conduits no longer prevent gravships from landing.
Supply shelves can now store more types of objects without the restrictions of vanilla shelves.
Added compatibility with Trader ships. Right-click a landed trader ship to trade with it through magic storage.
You can now claim rewards for completing the tutorial.
Increased building hit points and adjusted movement slowdown when passing through buildings.
Added the production output port, allowing supplies in its connected storage network to be delivered directly to workbenches for production. Production jobs only.
The Nivarian mass driver now requires basic magic storage instead of Nivarian mass driver logistics, so you can supply Nivarians through the Nivarian mass driver extractor.
The absorption range of storage receivers can now be changed. Placing stockpiles around them effectively improves how smoothly hauling runs.

Previously, vanilla workbenches could only recognize the quantity of manufactured resource items stored in Magic Storage. They can now recognize the quantity of manufactured items of every category stored in Magic Storage.
Further improved material compatibility in the build menu. Force compatibility mode is now enabled by default and can be turned off in the mod settings.
Added a copy button to the recipe list.
Fixed compatibility with special crafting recipes from some mods.
Fixed corpses displaying incorrectly on restocking shelves.
Prevented items on restocking shelves from being picked up opportunistically while hauling.
You can now choose which room type a workbench counts as, such as a kitchen.
You can now use keyboard shortcuts to jump to a core or quickly activate buttons. See the settings to configure them.
Added practical tips to the tutorial.
Further improved compatibility with the Nivarian cryo-forge.
Improved compatibility with Holy Washer.

The cosmic workbench can now benefit from tool cabinets. If similar buildings from other mods cannot affect the cosmic workbench, support will not be considered, as this is due to shortcomings in those mods' implementation.
Improved the details shown when materials are insufficient.
Improved workbench page performance for a smoother experience.
Workbenches are now affected by the room system.
Fixed an issue where silver on restocking shelves was not correctly recognized during trade.
You can now restrict work types at individual workbenches, giving you more control over your kitchen layout.
Improved the placement destination button on the recipe page.
Added a compatibility setting that allows blueprints to be placed using all material types. Enable it only when a mod conflict prevents materials from being recognized.
Restocking shelf settings can now be saved locally.
Items in storage can now be given directly to beggars.
Added support for dynamically generated sculpture recipes from the Ideology DLC.
Fixed an error after uninstalling a storage receiver.
Added compatibility with Milira Imperium trade ships.
Improved compatibility with dd.Logical Floors.
Completing basic magic storage research now sends a notice about trading with magic storage.
Magic storage trade options now appear at the top of the menu.
Added tutorial hints.
The restocking shelf's filter mode configuration page now includes a distinct item types option.
Continuous supply now supports per-item target inventory limits, preventing excessive transfers into the destination container.
You can now submit suggestions and bug reports from the storage core or the mod settings.
Skill ranges can now be set to unlimited.
Improved messages when a trade fails.
The construction supply unit can now automatically repair broken-down facilities. This feature can be disabled on the building.
Improved recipe grouping priority settings. Work order is affected by groups.
The default placement of new orders can now be configured in the mod settings.
Added grouping mode to the workbench recipe list.
Fixed a trade compatibility bug.
Added quick food setup to restocking shelves.
Added dd.Logical Floors compatibility for the construction supply unit.
Both restocking shelves can now serve as hoppers for nutrient paste dispensers.
Added the high-stack restocking shelf with 10 storage slots.
Added compatibility with Raven Race's gifting system.
Added compatibility with Monolyn Race's production facilities.
Added a public entry point for the trade window to make integration easier for third-party mods.
Cosmic workbench lists now allow workbenches to be marked with a cross, moving them to the bottom.
Added compatibility with CeleTech Arsenal's trade shuttles.
Added filter mode to the auto-restocking shelf. Select multiple item types, and the shelf will automatically choose items it can stock.
Added compatibility with [FSF] Complex Jobs.
Improved feedback when the mech gestator has insufficient materials.
Improved the mech gestator's material retrieval logic.
The construction supply unit's supply radius can now be configured.
Fixed a bug that allowed storage conduits and hidden storage conduits to be uninstalled and moved.
Initial release of Magic Storage.
